correctness.rationale: For invertible structure matrix, any automorphism is monomial and a determinant-supported matching constrains the finite diagonal group. Its possible torsion primes 3,5,7,31 split into exhaustive cases with bounds 36,72,60,126,155 and 120 for trivial D. Distinct diagonal characters force exact support in the 31,5 and 9 cases; characteristic D partitions restrict H in the 3 case. Complex five-cycle realizes 31×5 and weighted versions normalize by a 31st-root equation. Direct exhaustive checker validates all 3304 nontrivial-diagonal labeled supports.

value.rationale: Settles the natural five-dimensional case of two explicit recent maximum-automorphism conjectures, gives the sharp universal bound even over arbitrary fields, and identifies the unique complex equality class via a structural graph argument. It also proves the maximizing example simple rather than only providing a numerical calculation.
